technical.summary: Mixed intermediate-term bullish structure (supertrend, Ichimoku, EMA 20/50) undermined by price trading below key short-term moving averages, weak momentum indicators, and Bollinger Band squeeze limiting breakout potential.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 29 days adds timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: junior representative small purchases offset by larger sale 58-69 days ago; market fear (41/100) presents contrarian opportunity but lack of senior conviction and disabled news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (317) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational IT earnings, and earnings event in 29 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud, and EMA 20/50 bullish structure provide intermediate-term directional support with price near support level (287.633) offering defined risk entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 317, strong dollar), price below all short-term moving averages, weak momentum (RSI/Stochastic/Williams %R not rising), BB squeeze limiting volatility, zero fundamental conviction, and earnings binary risk in 29 days create overwhelming downside risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Price at support (287.633) with intermediate-term bullish structure (supertrend, Ichimoku, EMA 20/50) offers defined risk entry. However, severe macro headwinds, weak momentum, and zero fundamental conviction overwhelm this technical setup.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve + VIX crisis (317) + earnings binary in 29 days create compounding downside risk; price below all short-term MAs signals momentum failure despite intermediate-term structure.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
